events.title: Historic Lewes Farmers Market – Fall Saturday Season
events.description: The market shifts to its fall Saturday schedule at the Lewes Elementary School parking lot, running through early December.
events.venue: Lewes Elementary School parking lot, 820 Savannah Rd.
events.editorialNote: Season transition worth flagging so readers don't show up at the summer location.

events.title: Bridgeville Apple-Scrapple Festival
events.description: Bridgeville's signature fall festival weekend, with Thursday carnival night followed by Friday and Saturday food, entertainment, vendors and contests downtown.
events.editorialNote: Thursday is Hometown Carnival Night; the main festival opens Friday at 4 p.m. and Saturday at 9 a.m.

events.title: October Trails Day at Cape Henlopen
events.description: Volunteer-led monthly trail clean-up and restoration day hosted by the Friends of Cape Henlopen State Park.
events.sourceOrg: Friends of Cape Henlopen State Park
events.editorialNote: The calendar confirms date/time; registration, cost and meeting-point details were not published in the source checked.

events.title: Boast the Coast Maritime Festival
events.description: Free canal-side maritime festival kicking off Lewes Maritime Weekend: Freedom Boat Club canal tours, live music from Jgar, kids' entertainment, free admission to the Cannonball House, and a paid one-hour narrated history cruise with Cape Water Tours.
events.editorialNote: Pairs naturally with Coast Day the next morning — a genuine Lewes maritime weekend.

events.title: Coast Day — 50th Anniversary
events.description: The University of Delaware's coastal, marine, and environmental science open house marks its 50th anniversary at the Hugh R. Sharp Campus, with hands-on activities, live demonstrations, and lab and ship tours. A fifth-grade essay contest on 'Habitats and Ecosystems of Delaware' accepts entries through Oct. 9.
events.venue: University of Delaware Hugh R. Sharp Campus, 700 Pilottown Rd.
events.sourceOrg: University of Delaware College of Earth, Ocean & Environment
events.editorialNote: The 50th anniversary is this issue's lead. The Lewes Chamber calendar lists 10 a.m.–3 p.m.; UD's page did not print hours, so confirm before publishing times.

events.title: Lewes Merchants' Fall Sidewalk Sale
events.description: Annual sidewalk sale along Lewes's shopping district, daily during the maritime-weekend stretch.

events.title: Delaware Botanic Gardens Welcome Walks
events.description: Guided one-hour welcome walks at Delaware Botanic Gardens at Pepper Creek.
events.venue: Delaware Botanic Gardens, 30220 Piney Neck Rd.

events.title: Scarecrow Trail and Show
events.description: Community-decorated scarecrow trail throughout the Rehoboth-Dewey resort area, running the full month of October.
events.sourceOrg: Rehoboth Beach-Dewey Beach Chamber of Commerce

events.title: Cape Henlopen Hawk Watch
events.description: A fall hawk watch at Cape Henlopen State Park, part of the Hawk Migration Association of North America network. A professional raptor counter is on site most days alongside Sussex Bird Club volunteers; the count is supported by a Fish and Wildlife grant. No experience needed. Counts are posted at hawkcount.org.
events.sourceOrg: Friends of Cape Henlopen State Park
events.editorialNote: Strong recurring nature-desk anchor for the whole fall season, not just this week.

events.title: Sweeney Todd: A Musical Thriller
events.description: Musical theater run at the Milton Theatre, with performances through this issue's week.
events.editorialNote: Individual performance times vary by date (e.g., 2 p.m. and 7:30 p.m. shows) — confirm exact showtimes with Milton Theatre box office before publishing.

events.title: Mysteries of History Walking Tour
events.description: Zwaanendael Museum walking tour exploring the darker and more unusual history of Lewes.
events.displayDate: Select dates in October (1, 3, 10, 15, 17, 24, 29, 31) at 2 p.m.
events.sourceOrg: Lewes Chamber of Commerce / Zwaanendael Museum

events.title: True Blue Jazz Festival
events.description: 14th-year jazz festival with multiple venues and performances across Lewes.
events.editorialNote: Full lineup/venue list not yet available from this source — worth a follow-up check closer to the date.

events.title: The Rocky Horror Show
events.description: Clear Space Theatre production with late-night audience-participation performances every Saturday.
events.displayDate: Oct. 9–31, with special Saturday late-night shows

events.title: Enzian Musikanten Oktoberfest Concert
events.description: Oktoberfest-themed seaside concert with musicians and dancers, part of Bethany Beach's 125th-anniversary concert series.

events.title: Puppy Pals Live! Dog Stunt Show
events.description: Family-friendly touring dog stunt show, closing out Bethany Beach's 2026 seaside concert/entertainment series.

events.title: Lightship Overfalls — Last Regular Open Day of the Season
events.description: Last regular public open day of the season aboard the Lightship Overfalls in Canalfront Park. The ship returns for a Haunted Ship event Oct. 30–31.
events.editorialNote: Worth a reminder note for readers who want a last look before the off-season.
